out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. One handsink did not have paper towels.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: containers of jook (a cooked rice porridge product) has dates of 9/1/26 on them, which exceeded the date marking limit of 7 days by 10 days. The product had been frozen after it was cooked, and the date was not changed.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. When freezing foods cooked and cooled in the establishment, there is still only a 7 day limit for keeping it. The days before freezing and after thawing count towards the 7 days limit. If food is cooked, cooled, and held for two days, then frozen, it can only be kept and used for five more days after thawing. The PIC discarded the jook because it had exceed the 7 days limit. REST ASSURED CATERING (Inspection Date: 09/17/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. A spray bottle of sanitizer and a sanitizing wiping cloth container was stored with food and food equipment on the bottom shelf of a work table.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The PIC moved the chemicals during the inspection.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. The PIC discussed this with the employee wearing a bracelet.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. There is an unapproved splitter installed on the mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. If the splitter is needed, replace it with a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve. The PIC disconnected the unapproved splitter and turned off the water supply during the inspection to temporarily correct the issue. The EHS provided the PIC with an image of the approved splitter and the PIC was going to order it.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Provided for Paper Towel Disposal
violations.observation: There is no refuse container at the area immediately adjacent to the 3-compartment sink hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: If disposable paper towels are used at handwashing sinks, a trash can shall be located at each sink or group of adjacent sinks. The PIC moved a trash can to this area during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. There was one unlabeled spray bottle of degreaser stored on the shelf next to the 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The PIC labeled the bottle during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: vegan pesto in the Delfield 2-door refrigerator was 50F. Garlic in oil was 48F, guacamole was 46F, balsamic was 46, and milk was 48F in the Avantco 5-drawer unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. All foods listed above were discarded. Other foods in these unit were moved to the walk-in.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the 5-drawer Delfield unit and the Avantco unit in the back prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. The manager will not use these units until repaired. Repair as soon as possible. REST ASSURED CATERING (Inspection Date: 10/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not designed or constructed to be easily cleanable: Observed 5-gallon manufacturer food bucket being reused.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. The manager removed the buckets during the inspection.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There was no covered trash can in the unisex restrooms.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.Please provide covers for the existing trash cans, or install additional covered trash cans for feminine hygiene products. Correct before the next routine inspection.
